sources.title: HealthBench: Evaluating Large Language Models - arXiv.org
sources.snippet: Abstract We present HealthBench, an open-source benchmark measuring the performance and safety of large language models in healthcare. HealthBench consists of 5,000 multi-turn conversations between a model and an individual user or healthcare professional. Responses are evaluated using conversation-specific rubrics created by 262 physicians.
